claim: `Nat.ordCompl_eq_self_iff_zero_or_not_dvd` unnecessarily assumes `hp : Prime p`; for non-prime `p`, `ordCompl_of_not_prime` gives the same equality, so the iff can cover all `p`.
requested_change:
Replace it by the stronger theorem
```lean
theorem ordCompl_eq_self_iff (n p : ℕ) :
    ordCompl[p] n = n ↔ ¬p.Prime ∨ n = 0 ∨ ¬p ∣ n := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_cases hp : p.Prime
    · right
      by_cases n_zero : n = 0
      · simp [n_zero]
      · right
        rw [← h]
        exact not_dvd_ordCompl hp n_zero
    · exact Or.inl hp
  · rintro (not_prime | n_eq_zero | not_dvd)
    · simp [not_prime]
    · simp [n_eq_zero]
    · have : n.factorization p = 0 := Nat.factorization_eq_zero_of_not_dvd not_dvd
      rw [this]
      simp
```
